assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin B uses subject "admin-b" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Import Map fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And the Import Map grid has record "101" owned by "FMO_ADMIN"
4. And the baseline fixture data defines "Module Name" as "container-087"
5. And the baseline fixture data defines "Path" as "https://fixture.example/case-087.js"
6. And Import Map record "101" is inactive when this browser loads its grid
8. When Admin B clicks the button labeled "Verify" in the Import Map grid row with "Record Id" "101"
9. Then the dialog titled "verify ID: 101" is visible on the Import Map administration page
10. When Admin A completes a controlled maker update after this verification dialog loads
11. And Admin B clicks the button labeled "Verified" in dialog "verify ID: 101"
12. Then the alert with severity "error" in the portal snackbar displays the agreed message for a stale-verification error
